title: Structured Output Prompts
description: Master prompting for structured outputs like JSON, XML, and parsing responses reliably.

data.text: Structured output prompting asks the model to return data in specific formats like JSON or XML. This enables programmatic consumption of LLM outputs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Specify output format in system prompt
Provide schema or examples for JSON
data.takeaway: Structured output enables programmatic integration of LLM outputs. Use function calling when available, otherwise prompt carefully and validate outputs.
